answer: To register, an agent must lock real collateral and pass an in-person attestation; forging duplicates costs the full collateral plus the token's resale value, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work by bonding each identity to a scarce physical token, like a carved marble stamped with a unique island provenance mark and verified jade seal. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
